I managed to get FISP coupons this season, so I will apply subsidized NPK and urea to my main maize plot because this is where my family gets its food. I will also put manure from our goats on this plot, and I will use the improved seed that comes with the subsidy. We cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so my wife, children, and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, which will take many days across the season.
